reviews.text:
目元がすっきりして、使った後はとても気持ちいいです。
使いやすくて、目元のケアにぴったりだと思います。
手軽に使えるので、気に入っています！
reviews.zh:
眼部睇落清爽咗，用完之後感覺好舒服。
好易用，好啱做眼部護理。
用起嚟好方便，所以好鍾意！

reviews.text: This eyebrow pencil is very easy to use, even beginners can draw with it effortlessly. The color looks natural, and the brow brush is really handy.
reviews.zh: 呢支眉筆好易用，就算係新手都可以輕鬆畫眉。顏色睇落好自然，眉刷都好方便。

reviews.text: Firm yet smooth pencil glides on without tugging. 02 Medium Brown is natural taupe-brown perfect for cool-toned hair. Creates hair-like strokes easily. Built-in spoolie blends seamlessly. Long-lasting, smudge-proof formula. Great value daily essential .
reviews.zh: 筆芯結實但順滑，畫落去唔會扯。02 Medium Brown 係自然嘅灰褐棕色，好啱冷色調髮色。容易畫出似毛髮嘅線條。內置嘅眉梳刷可以無痕融合。持久、防暈染配方。性價比高，係日常必備。

reviews.text: The brush is really something different from other products! I like it~ Its colour is natural and won’t be too hard-core, but it’s kinda too easy to wipe off!
reviews.zh: 呢個刷頭真係同其他產品好唔同！我好鍾意～顏色自然，唔會太濃，不過好似太容易擦走咗！

reviews.text: Reminds me of the Nyx one I used to use, but more natural. The color I got is a super close color to my dirty blonde hair, so I wouldn’t call it dark brown?
reviews.zh: 令我諗起以前用嘅 Nyx 嗰支，但係更自然。我買嗰個顏色同我嘅暗金髮好接近，所以我唔會話係深啡色？

reviews.text: i love it!! i use it to outline the end of my eyebrow and fill it in a bit, it doesn’t make my eyebrows look too dark like the many many other brow pencils i’ve used ^_^ the brush is also really good for blending it out or just brushing your eyebrow back into place!!
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意！！我用嚟描眉尾，再稍微填滿一下，唔會似我試過嘅好多其他眉筆咁，眉毛畫到太深。個刷頭都好好用嚟暈開，或者係將眉毛梳返整齊！！ ^_^

reviews.text: It's a hard formula type eye brow pencil. I think the brush doesn't work as well as a spoolie and kind of pushes the product into clumps for me. The colour is very nice though.
reviews.zh: 呢支係較硬嘅配方嘅眉筆。我覺得個刷頭唔及梳刷咁好用，而且對我嚟講會令產品結成一團團。不過個顏色好靚。

reviews.text: This brow pencil is very easy to use for beginners! I started drawing brows for the first time and I like that this pencil is not too strongly colored. Experts might not like that for the same reason but for beginners like me it's easy to draw multiple times in layers for more defined brows. I also like the brush that blends the pencil strokes very naturally. The pencil is retractable so you can screw the bottom around in both directions. Recommended!
reviews.zh: 呢支眉筆對新手嚟講好易用！我第一次畫眉，我好鍾意呢支眉筆顏色唔會太深。專家可能會因為同一個原因唔鍾意，但係對我呢種新手嚟講，可以分層多次畫，眉形就會更清晰。我亦好鍾意個刷頭，可以好自然咁融合筆觸。呢支筆可以伸縮，你可以向兩邊扭底部。推薦！

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
